hooks.name: eve-sdl-win-precheck
hooks.description: Windows-only SDL prerequisite check (WARNING, non-blocking). Runs once per session under bun (native on Windows, fires even without a POSIX shell) and, if git is missing / not on PATH on Windows, prints an install directive so the user installs Git for Windows (which supplies both git and the sh/bash the SDL .sh hooks + git pre-commit scan need). Silent no-op on macOS/Linux and when git is present. SessionStart cannot block; the sh eve-sdl-gate still hard-blocks the Windows-with-sh case.
